template_name: Environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act
description: The sequence a California lead agency runs when reviewing a project under the state's environmental quality act: preliminary review, the document-type decision, technical studies, a public draft, responses, and certification or adoption.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the notice-to-proceed date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.

This template assumes a project in California reviewed under the California Environmental Quality Act, and it is the only assumption in the set that names a state. A project anywhere else should use the jurisdiction-neutral environmental review template instead.

The offsets are placeholders, not the review periods. California's review periods, notice requirements and filing steps vary by document type and by whether a state agency is a reviewing agency — confirm the ones that apply to your project and replace these dates.
It stops at certification or adoption. Post-approval mitigation monitoring runs for the life of the project and belongs in its own record set.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Project description and preliminary review
deliverables.summary: A description stable enough to review, and the preliminary determination of whether the activity is subject to review at all.

deliverables.title: Initial study and environmental checklist
deliverables.summary: The checklist analysis that supports the decision on which kind of document is required.

deliverables.title: Supporting technical studies
deliverables.summary: The traffic, biological, cultural, noise, air and other studies the initial study identified as necessary.

deliverables.title: Draft environmental document for public review
deliverables.summary: The complete draft prepared for the public review period.

deliverables.title: Responses to comments received
deliverables.summary: Written responses to the substantive environmental comments received during review.

deliverables.title: Final environmental document
deliverables.summary: The final document incorporating the responses.

deliverables.title: Findings and mitigation monitoring and reporting program
deliverables.summary: The findings the decision-making body must make and the program that will track every adopted mitigation measure.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, the review path and the schedule confirmed with the lead agency.

milestones.title: Decision on the type of environmental document
milestones.summary: The lead agency decides which document the project requires, on the record.

milestones.title: Public review period opens
milestones.summary: The draft is circulated for the review period that applies to it.

milestones.title: Public hearing on the draft document
milestones.summary: The hearing held before the decision-making body acts.

milestones.title: Certification or adoption of the final document
milestones.summary: The decision-making body certifies or adopts the final document and makes its findings.
